events.text: CRITIQUE ROUND 2 — PART-RANGE CORRUPTION (the 'unfuck that one' order). Repro: new cube -> loop cuts applied -> add second cube part -> outliner scoping is garbage: focusing Cube 1 highlights ONLY the thin loop-cut middle band (not the cube); focusing Cube 2 highlights a chunk overlapping the ORIGINAL cube's lower half; moving each part tears the mesh apart along those wrong ranges; unfocusing ALL parts (which should not even be possible) selects/moves EVERYTHING as one and shows all faces. Diagnosis hypothesis (strong): parts are tracked as {lo,hi} vertex ranges; topo ops (loop cut) insert verts and the cart patches the ACTIVE part's range from the op's returned lo/hi (= just the newly created band) instead of re-deriving ALL part ranges from the host's authoritative face-group mapping; subsequent appended parts then land on shifted offsets. Fix contract: after EVERY topo op/undo/redo, all part ranges re-derived from host truth (read-back door if needed); moves scope to the ACTIVE part always; zero-focused-parts state eliminated (one part always active). ALSO this round: (QQ) lc handle drag WORKS but is freehand-only — should STEP in size units by default (snap to u ticks), freehand on a held modifier; (RR) gizmo view-angle precision growth imperceptible — tune or fix (user: 'unaffected by PoV').

FIXED (7c08b2a7c). Root cause was FOUR breaks, all verified: (1) plane-cut mints fresh authored-group ids past max (mesh_edit.zig planeCutSoup) — a cut cube's 6 groups become 18 but the cart kept [0,6) and NOTHING re-derived ranges from the host (pre-fix headless proof: range 0,6 selected 5/18 faces = the one slab the user saw); (2) model_source.retain() cleared part ranges on EVERY edit replace, and extrude/create-face dropped face grouping entirely; (3) zero-focus was the outliner row toggling active off -> scope(0,0) = whole-buffer drags; (4) req_2645 SS: outliner row click called selectFacesByGroupRange which FORCES host pick mode to face — vertex toolbar, face picking. Fix contract delivered: host maintains part ranges through every topo op (renormalizePartRanges + per-face parentage chained through lc previews), ONE read-back door __mesh_part_ranges, cart resyncs after every op/undo/redo and never patches lo/hi; no zero-focus; vertex/edge focus no longer flips pick mode. Partition audits headless: pre-cut [0,6) 12/12, post-cut [0,18) 84/84, +addpart [0,18)+[18,24) 96/96, undo/redo both OK; move isolation PNG shows whole cut part moving as one; post-cut vertex pick selects a VERTEX. QQ landed (lc drag snaps 1/16-world-u, Shift=freehand — needs live sanity check, no headless mouse driver). RR landed (growth onset 0.55, thicker stroke side-on, measured 273px/4px vs 288px/7px in shots). Left open: object-mode focus still face-flips (intentional highlight UX), decimation still clears ranges (pre-existing, documented pre-paint step).
